items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I played a job with Kid Rene with Wooden Joe

ctx.x: You were going to go on with your life there. Excuse the interruption, he's one of the great trumpet players. We never knew him before.

Yes he was, he was very great. And like I was telling you, I started playing trumpet around here and some of the small outfits. No name outfit. I played quite a few jobs with Burbank and several jobs. And several jobs with two trumpets. I played a job with Kid Rene with Wooden Joe, you were the one with Joe Nickles. Boy I knew Wooden Joe, yeah very well. And also with Bill N. D. D. And I played a job with Paul Dominguez, the violinist. I played several jobs right there, especially during the pression. They had…
